sheets.title: Settings › Capabilities: the review for switching WebMCP tools on — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: A guest switches WebMCP tools on, and the review opens before anything is applied. Before, the review said reload after enabling: WebMCP tools. That was never true: verify:webmcp chooses WebMCP after boot and reads its four native tools without a reload. Nothing enforced the flag until this PR taught the loader to hold such a capability back (RELOAD_REQUIRED). Enforced, the false flag broke that gate, so the flag is now truthful and the row reads —. Every other row is unchanged.
